material.description: Facts (origin/main b62d476): rust/crates/web/site/main.js:241-244 has no POST; relay route rust/crates/server/src/lib.rs:208 and relay.rs:43 exist. The browser job (.github/workflows/ci.yml:138) serves the page with python3 -m http.server, which returns 501 to POST. Needed: serve the page from oscraftd or proxy same-origin, add the POST in the main.js catch, and a CI check asserting one client-error line in server.log.
material.resolution: Blocker cleared: oscraftd serves the page at /site/ and the page POSTs caught errors to /client-error; the browser job checks one server log line.
material.subject: Client error catch never POSTs to /client-error and the browser CI cannot receive the POST (gap-client-error-relay-wiring)
